name: Mirai ni Kiss o -Kiss the Future-
original_name: 未来にキスを -Kiss the Future-
source:
Due to certain circumstances, my parents are living in a foreign country, and I'm staying with my rich aunt. I'm getting pretty used to life in a new home. My old childhood friend who I've become estranged from, comes back into my life-- her name is Asukai Kasumi. Kasumi is my aunt's only daughter, and I used to play with her a lot. Even though we were the same age, she always called me "Onii-chan". Seeing her now, she's just as cute as she was back then. She's put in the same class in school as I am, and our everyday life begins...

About six months have passed since then. My aunt and uncle are going on a trip for two weeks, leaving me and Kasumi alone in this huge house. The first night we were alone, Kasumi comes into my room. She asked to sleep together, and while I was still bewildered just from this, she smiles at me and asks me a question.

"Onii-chan, will you make me your slave?"

[description from getchu]
translation:
由於某些原因，我的父母住在國外，而我寄住在富有的姑媽家。我漸漸習慣了新家的生活。與我疏遠多年的青梅竹馬重新回到我的生活中，她名叫飛鳥井霞。霞是姑媽唯一的女兒，我們以前常常一起玩。儘管同歲，她總叫我「哥哥」。如今再見，她依然和從前一樣可愛。她被分到和我同一班，我們的日常生活就此開始……

大約半年後，姑媽和姑丈外出旅行兩週，留下我和霞獨自在這棟大房子裡。獨處的第一晚，霞來到我的房間，提出想和我一起睡。光是這樣已令我不知所措，她卻笑著問了我一個問題。

「哥哥，你願意把我變成你的奴隸嗎？」

[簡介摘自Getchu]
